summary: cTrader OAuth2 access-token auto-refresh, implemented ONCE in the shared broker client and wired into S011 only (Anton: 'если надо для этого брокера сделать глобально - переноси запросы на клиент для этой стратегии... чтобы CTrader работал для всех одинаково' + 'и используй клиент пока только для 011'). Motivated by the live outage found in this session's S011 diagnosis: 2026-09-21 00:00 -> 2026-09-22 09:45, 130 consecutive cycles failed with CH_ACCESS_TOKEN_INVALID, and as a knock-on the ESTOXX50/DOW exit signalled 18.09 was rejected MARKET_CLOSED and only executed 4 days late. There was NO refresh mechanism before this: scripts/ctrader_oauth.py printed the refreshToken with an explicit 'not currently used, no auto-refresh wired up' note, and no grant_type=refresh_token call existed anywhere. (1) NEW bot/clients/ctrader/auth.py -- Twisted-free OAuth2 token layer: TokenBundle (access/refresh/expires_at, needs_refresh() with REFRESH_LEEWAY_S=3600, as_credentials()/from_credentials()), authorization_url(), exchange_authorization_code(), refresh_access_token() (handles the broker ROTATING the refresh token, keeps the old one when the answer omits it), is_expired_token_error(). Endpoints are the real ones (GET https://openapi.ctrader.com/apps/token with QUERY params, id.ctrader.com authorize) and now live in exactly one place. A missing or unparseable token_expires_at is deliberately treated as 'expires now' -- a needless refresh is cheap, a wrong 'still valid' is an outage. (2) bot/clients/ctrader/client.py substantially refactored. It was structurally broken and had never been imported by anything: every public method ran its own reactor.run(), but a Twisted reactor can only run once per OS process, so the SECOND call in a process was impossible. Now the reactor runs ONCE on a module-level daemon thread (_ensure_reactor_running, installSignalHandlers=False, guarded by reactor._startedBefore -- NOT _stopped, which is True before the reactor has ever run) and every public method is a synchronous wrapper over threads.blockingCallFromThread. Each operation is split into a _xxx_step() returning a Deferred plus a thin public wrapper via _call/_blocking_call (CALL_TIMEOUT_S=60, CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S=90), so composite flows cost ONE connect/auth. Added open()/close()/__enter__/__exit__, session-level symbol caching (the old design re-downloaded the whole symbol list on every single call), resolve_symbols()/get_symbols_details()/get_trendbars_many() for portfolio strategies, place_stop_order, and notional= + notional_price= sizing alongside volume_lots= so both the lot-sizing (S007/S021) and dollar-weight (S011) strategies are served by the same methods. Token refresh is PRE-FLIGHT (_ensure_fresh_token runs before the reactor is touched), never retry-on-failure -- a session that dies on an expired token cannot be retried in the same process. close() deliberately does NOT stop the reactor (it cannot be restarted; stopping would break every later client in the process). Fixed a real bug found by the new tests: _load_symbols returned the raw protobuf message on a cold cache but self._symbols on a warm one. (3) bot/ctrader_s011.py rewritten to COMPOSE CTraderApiClient instead of subclassing the legacy CTraderAdapter -- S011 is the first strategy migrated; the others stay on bot/ctrader.py and move over one at a time. All broker protocol code is gone from it; what stayed is genuinely S011's own: the D1 session-date relabelling (D1_SESSION_DATE_ROLL -- the shared client deliberately returns neutral UTC bars), _drop_forming_bar, _last_closed_price (the guard for the 2026-08-19 ~5.7x oversized CAC40 order), and the portfolio-shaped run_live_cycle_multi, which is now plain sequential code inside one `with self.client as broker:`. New public fetch_session_dated_bars() is shared with scripts/s011_check_d1_alignment.py, which no longer needs a private subclass. (4) Credential storage: refresh_token + token_expires_at added to webapp/schemas/accounts.py's CtraderCredentials (both optional -- accounts authorised before this keep working) and to bot/config.py::ctrader_credentials(). NO DB migration needed: credentials_enc is an encrypted JSON dict. webapp/runner.py's THREE duplicated creds-building blocks (S007/S011/S021) collapsed into one _ctrader_creds(acc), and a new _token_persister(session, acc) writes a renewed token back and commits immediately -- passed to S011's cycle via a new on_token_refreshed param threaded through bot/s011_paper.py. Without that callback a refresh is forgotten at cycle end and, once the broker rotates the refresh token, the next cycle would renew with a dead one. (5) scripts/ctrader_oauth.py now delegates to bot/clients/ctrader/auth.py (one implementation of the token endpoints) and gained --db-account, which stores the whole bundle into a webapp Account's encrypted credentials -- the path the scheduled runner actually reads. --write still only patches configs/accounts.yml, which is the single-account CLI path. webapp UI: optional 'Refresh token' field on add_account. (6) Tests: 3 new files, 34 new tests -- tests/bot/test_ctrader_auth.py (refresh grant, rotation, expiry parsing, leeway, expired-token detection), tests/bot/test_ctrader_client_session.py (fake SDK client: lazy/idempotent open, FIVE sequential calls in one process, symbol cache downloaded once, pre-flight refresh reaching the account-auth request, auth rejection surfaced not swallowed), tests/bot/test_ctrader_s011_client.py (session-date relabelling incl. no caller mutation, order priced off the last CLOSED bar, one rejected instrument does not abort the portfolio), tests/webapp/test_runner_ctrader_creds.py (creds merge, commit, round trip). Full suite: 442 passed; the 3 failures (podman_healthcheck x2, s007_tick) are pre-existing in Anton's uncommitted work and untouched by this change, and tests/strategies/test_eia_calendar.py is skipped locally (no `holidays` package). FOLLOW-UP OWED: bot/clients/ is shared-base code owned by the code-architecture skill, which still documents bot/ctrader.py as THE cTrader base for all strategies. Per that skill's own governance rule the update must be PROPOSED to Anton and applied only with his consent -- proposed at the end of this session, not yet applied.
